value.body: A lab animal veterinarian looks after animals used in research and drug-safety studies, and makes sure they are housed and handled under animal-welfare rules. Contract research organisations, pharma R&D centres and research institutes hire them. The work mixes animal health care, support for study procedures and detailed record-keeping.

items.label: Rules followed
items.value: CPCSEA guidelines and institutional animal ethics committee approvals

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers usually join a contract research organisation or pharma research facility as a veterinarian or study associate, with training in good laboratory practice (GLP) on the job.

value.title: At a glance
items: Common next roles: study director support, senior facility veterinarian, toxicology roles.
An MVSc or a pathology/pharmacology specialisation opens senior research roles.
The work suits those interested in science over clinical practice.
